reformulation: Solver-blind finding: the 14,387-var/10,765-row MPS has minimum -160 with a bijective parameterization of every optimizer by 175 one-hot vectors (2,801 vars/175 rows). Kernel receipt RPA 9: 3 directional claims + 1 complete point, 12,630,928 B RPA / 9,130,685 B RPX, 494 B request, VERIFIED.
claim_class: Optimal-face contract, no whole-feasible-set or LP claim: (0) unrestricted source->target constant map, NonIncreasing, input_objective_lower=-160; (1) source restricted by input_objective_level=-160 -> target, Equal, inverse=2; (2) reverse target->source, Equal, inverse=1, whose Return must also prove the mapped objective equals -160 (opposing-level closure); plus one complete 14,387-coordinate feasible source point at -160. Claims 0+3 give optimality and attainment, 1+2 the bijection. No improvements, halfspace, projection or V7 bijection mechanism is used.
claims: claim 0: unrestricted source->target constant map (the real forward map evaluated at the attainment point), NonIncreasing, input_objective_lower=-160; 1 Lin step, 8,580 obligations.

claim 1: source restricted by input_objective_level=-160 -> target, Equal, inverse=2, integer modes; 79,429 steps, 22,966 obligations; derives P=0/B=1, X<=Y, one-hot Y, 528 vector pairs, forest equality over 5 components.

claim 2: reverse target->source, Equal, inverse=1; 786 steps, 56,729 obligations; 10,765 per-source-row certificates with residual maxima 0:10321, -1:442, -310:1, -61:1, plus the mandatory opposing-level equality EQ(f_source(G(y))+160).
one Feasible point claim: complete 14,387-coordinate integer source point at objective -160, checked against every source domain and row.

request.json equals exactly these 3 claims and the point (494 B); nine deterministic mutations all INVALID, including a -159 attaining point, a dropped closure equality and a dropped original inverse coordinate.
proof_encoding: RPA 9 text 12,630,928 B = claims prefix + three blocks with steps [1, 79429, 786]; RPX 9,130,685 B; kernel view 88,275 terminal obligations, 848,557 linear terms, 70,752 substitution terms, 79,429 peak live facts, 4,881,992 work of the 1e9 default.

Forward face: one kernel-created level row with 3,331 terms, a balanced 3,331-leaf sum tree (Lin) plus EqPair descent fixing P=0/B=1, 528 link vector pairs of 16 positions each k-scaled Lin + Round + Int, 221 one-hot EqPairs, spanning-forest propagation, zero branches.

Reverse: one Lin(Eq) scaling by 160 of the proved obj_constant-1 equality (the fixed initial failure), then 10,765 row certificates consumed as data, each a combination of target equality rows plus a residual bounded by target bounds.

Return checks are positional: per output coordinate lower/upper/Int, per output row one row-fact, the objective relation, per input coordinate of the inverse, then the level-membership equality, then input_objective_lower.
All 10,765 reverse source rows collapse to 786 Lin steps because certificates are shared by expression; equality-residual rows must be identically zero, inequalities bounded by 0, -1, -310, -61.

Rebuilt the whole reverse direction itself: substitution of every original row, equality-multiplier search, residual bounds, plus 19-23 emitted-artifact roundtrips, and persisted a 9,121 B output/verify.py replaying hashes, maps, certificates and smoke lifts (digest evals 'Writing exact reconstruction and certificates', 'Replaying independent persisted audit').
